name: jlcpcb_2layer
process: Rigid FR-4, 2 layers, 1 oz outer copper, routed board edges

source.title: PCB Manufacturing & Assembly Capabilities - JLCPCB (section: Rigid PCB Manufacturing Capabilities)
source.page_date_note: The page shows no last-updated date; its footer reads (c) 2026 JLCPCB.COM. Re-check before relying on it.

track_width_min_mm.row: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)

track_spacing_min_mm.row: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)

clearance_default_min_mm.row: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)
clearance_default_min_mm.note: Interpretation: applied to copper pairs the page gives no specific row for (via to via, via to pad, plated pad to plated pad, SMD pad to plated pad).

pad_to_track_min_mm.quote: Min. 0.1 mm (stay well above if possible). Min. 0.09 mm locally for BGA pads
pad_to_track_min_mm.note: The 0.09 mm BGA allowance is not used.

pth_to_track_min_mm.note: Interpretation: measured from the plated pad's copper to the track.

smd_pad_to_pad_min_mm.row: SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets)

pth_annular_ring_min_mm.quote: 1 oz: Recommended 0.25 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.18 mm
pth_annular_ring_min_mm.note: The absolute minimum is the limit; the 0.25 mm recommendation is not enforced.

npth_annular_ring_min_mm.note: Applied only to non-plated holes that have a copper pad larger than the hole.

via_diameter_over_hole_min_mm.quote: Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.

via_hole_min_mm.quote: 2-layer: 0.15mm hole size / 0.25mm via diameter (0.1mm hole size / 0.2mm via diameter only available for board thickness <=1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
via_hole_min_mm.note: The 0.1 mm option needs a thin board and a specific finish, which this profile does not assume.

drill_min_mm.quote: 2-layer: 0.15 - 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness <=1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)

pad_hole_to_hole_min_mm.note: Applied to any pair of holes that includes a pad hole.

copper_to_edge_min_mm.quote: Copper clearance from routed board edges: >=0.2 mm

hole_to_edge_min_mm.note: The page gives hole-to-edge only for castellated holes (>= 1 mm). Ordinary holes are reported UNVERIFIED.

board_min_x_mm.quote: FR4/Rogers/PTFE: 3 x 3 mm (these limits apply to PCBs with thickness >= 0.6 mm. Manual review required for thinner PCBs.)

board_min_size_thickness_min_mm.quote: These limits apply to PCBs with thickness >= 0.6 mm. Manual review required for thinner PCBs.

board_max_x_mm.quote: FR4(2-layer): 670 x 600 mm (these limits apply to PCBs with thickness >= 0.8 mm)

board_max_thickness_min_mm.quote: These limits apply to PCBs with thickness >= 0.8 mm. The thinner FR4 PCBs are 599 x 497 mm maximum.

board_max_thin_x_mm.quote: The thinner FR4 PCBs are 599 x 497 mm maximum.

board_max_thin_y_mm.quote: The thinner FR4 PCBs are 599 x 497 mm maximum.

conflicts_on_page.other: Min. drill diameter for 2- or more-layer PCBs is 0.1 mm (more costly!)
conflicts_on_page.why: The stricter value; 0.1 mm also needs thickness <= 1 mm and ENIG/OSP.

conflicts_on_page.other: 2-layer FR4 PCBs can reach a maximum size of 1020 x 600 mm.
